_about.role: Results-feed scout for NE, KS, OK, TX, MT, WY, CO, NM, UT, ID (Election Night, phase 1, research only)
_about.method: Each finding was checked with a few requests per site, one at a time and at least two seconds apart, using the kit's User-Agent (congress-catalog/1.0, personal legislative research). No CAPTCHA, bot wall or login was touched. Nothing was downloaded beyond page heads and small JSON or CSV answers. The Browser pane could not open a tab in this run. Status codes are what this machine saw on 2026-10-09.

verdicts.KS: blocked (election-night page 403 behind Cloudflare; official files readable after canvass)
verdicts.OK: blocked (403 at the load balancer; John saves exports by hand)
verdicts.MT: live-readable (with care: exports are form postbacks)
verdicts.WY: readable with care (PDF summaries per county, no live feed)

NE.system: Secretary of State's own ASP.NET results site on Azure Government (resultsSW.aspx, resultsCSV.aspx, ResultsExport.aspx; data service neresultswebservice.azurewebsites.us). Same platform family as New Mexico's.

feeds.address_pattern: https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/resultsCSV.aspx?text=All&type=CG&map=DIST (type codes from the home page: SW statewide, CG Congress, LD Legislature, PS Public Service Commission, SE State Board of Education, RG Regents, JD judicial retention, CC community college, LC Learning Community, NR natural resources districts, UT Metropolitan Utilities District, PP public power districts, RD reclamation districts, ED educational service units, PA statewide ballot measures)
feeds.updates: as counties upload on election night; each row carries CurrentDateTime; results began posting at 8 p.m. CT in 2024
feeds.notes: HTTP 200 application/text on 2026-10-09. Columns: RaceID, RaceName, PartyCode, AreaType, AreaNum, OfficeSeqNo, BallotOrder, CandidateID, CandidateName, CurrentDateTime, VoteFor, CandidateVotes, CandidatePercentage, PrecinctsReporting (e.g. ='0/438'). Already set up for the Nov 3 general with zero votes.

feeds.address_pattern: https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/resultsCSV.aspx?text=All&type=SW&map=CTY
feeds.notes: Same export pattern as Congress; not requested separately.

feeds.address_pattern: https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/resultsCSV.aspx?text=All&type=LD&map=DIST
feeds.notes: Nebraska's one-house, nonpartisan Legislature.

feeds.address_pattern: https://electionresults.nebraska.gov/ResultsExport.aspx?cat=SWALL: 'Statewide Export', 'Legislative Export' and one export per county, each an ASP.NET postback (__doPostBack with __VIEWSTATE)
feeds.notes: Page answered 200; the postback itself was not tried. Header fields show 1,322 precincts and 1,259,447 registered voters.

feeds.address_pattern: https://neresultswebservice.azurewebsites.us/ (the map service the page calls; New Mexico's twin has GetMapDataArchive?type=..&category=CTY)
feeds.notes: County-by-county figures for the map. The method name for the live election has not been confirmed.

races: State Board of Education, Regents, PSC
special districts (NRD, MUD, public power, ESU, community college, Learning Community)
NE.vote_types: Not in the CSV seen (no early/absentee/election-day columns). The canvass book gives totals only. Count order would need county sources.
NE.counties_separate: Yes, for county, city and school races. The state hosts county files at countyelectionresults.nebraska.gov/election_files/<County>/ (for example .../Hall/2026_Primary_unofficial_results.pdf). Douglas County: votedouglascounty-ne.gov. Lancaster: lancaster.ne.gov (Election Commissioner). Sarpy: sarpy.gov. These sites were not requested.
NE.past_test: The site shows only the current election (Nov 3, 2026 is already loaded with zero votes, last updated 10/6/2026 8:49 AM CT). For a replay, use the posted zero-vote pages now, the canvass books (sos.nebraska.gov/sites/default/files/doc/elections/2024/2024%20General%20Canvass%20Book.pdf), or New Mexico's twin system with past eids.
NE.nov3_id: No id in the address; the home page reads 'Unofficial Results, General Election November 3, 2026'.
NE.terms: None stated on the pages read.
NE.kit_already_reads: ballot/lists/ne.py: the final candidate list PDF and the primary canvass book from sos.nebraska.gov/elections. ballot/state_local_ne.py: the Secretary's candidate filing and state-level workbooks, past general canvass books (2020-2024), and county sample-ballot PDFs (Douglas, Lancaster, Sarpy, Buffalo, Madison, Adams, Washington, York, Phelps, Cherry).
NE.plan: Nebraska is one of the easiest. On election night the updater can read the CSV exports for SW, CG, LD and the other type codes every few minutes (a handful of small files) and match RaceID and CandidateID to the ballot rows already loaded. County-by-county numbers for the map come from the per-county exports (a form postback) or the map service. Local city and school results are county by county: start with the state-hosted county files and Douglas and Lancaster's own sites.

feeds.notes: HTTP 403 from Cloudflare on 2026-10-09, although the body was the real page (title 'Unofficial Kansas Election Results', keywords for the 2026 primary, meta ROBOTS NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW). A 403 is a refusal: do not get around it.

feeds.updates: once, after the State Board of Canvassers certifies (Dec 2 in 2024)
feeds.notes: Results page HTTP 200 (CloudFront) on 2026-10-09. Format is xlsx (recorded as csv-like tables).

races: judges (Court of Appeals, district and magistrate retention)
KS.vote_types: Not split in the official workbooks seen. The election-night page was not readable.
KS.counties_separate: Yes. Johnson County Election Office (jocoelection.org), Sedgwick County (sedgwick.gov elections), Wyandotte/KCK (wycokck.org), Shawnee (snco.us/election). None of these were requested.
KS.past_test: 2024 general precinct workbooks: https://sos.ks.gov/elections/24elec/2024-General-Election-United-States-House-of-Representatives-Precinct-Results.xlsx (and Senate, Kansas House, Kansas Senate, SBOE, courts, DA).

KS.kit_already_reads: ballot/lists/ks.py: the official primary vote totals PDF and the primary precinct workbooks from sos.ks.gov/elections/election-results.html. The November list waits for John's saved page in ballot_cache/ks/.
KS.plan: No live feed a script may read. Options: (1) John saves the election-night page from his browser every so often into a watched folder, as he does for Minnesota; (2) show Kansas through the news feed and the AP-free official sources only after canvass, using the precinct workbooks for the map. County sites (Johnson, Sedgwick) may publish readable election-night files; check them once each before November. Ask John which he prefers.

feeds.address_pattern: https://goelect.txelections.civixapps.com/api-ivis-system/api/s3/enr/electionConstants (list of elections, base64 JSON in 'upload'); https://goelect.txelections.civixapps.com/api-ivis-system/api/s3/enr/election/<ID> (record with base64 sections Home, Federal, StateWide, StateWideQ, Districted, OfficeSummary, Race, Lookups, ReportList)
feeds.updates: Home carries RefreshTime and LastUpdatedTime; counties report through the night (CountiesReporting CR of CT=254)
feeds.notes: HTTP 200 (cloudflare) on 2026-10-09. The Nov 3 election (ID 53815, 'O': N) currently returns only {'Version'}: the data is not loaded yet. The March primary record (53813) is 1.8 MB.

feeds.address_pattern: Federal section of /election/<ID>: Races[] with Candidates[] carrying V (votes), EV (early votes), PE (percent), P (party)
feeds.notes: Early vote split present (EV).

feeds.address_pattern: /api-ivis-system/api/s3/enr/electionReports/<ID>/<Report>/pdf (CountyByCountyCanvassReport, OfficialCanvassReport; base64 in JSON)
feeds.notes: The kit already reads the OfficialCanvassReport this way.

races: statewide judges and courts of appeals
special elections (House 93, Senate 22 on Nov 3: IDs 66734, 66618)

TX.counties_separate: Yes, for county, city and school races: Harris (harrisvotes.com), Dallas (dallascountyvotes.org), Tarrant (tarrantcountytx.gov elections), Bexar (bexar.org elections), Travis (votetravis.gov). Not requested.

TX.nov3_id: 53815 ('2026 NOVEMBER GENERAL ELECTION'); specials 66734 (House District 93) and 66618 (Senate District 22) on the same list.

TX.kit_already_reads: ballot/lists/tx.py: electionConstants, election records and Official Canvass Report PDFs for the 2026 primaries and runoffs. ballot/state_local_tx.py: the qualified-candidates API (findQualifiedCandidates, election 53815) and the Ballot Certification Report.

WY.system: Secretary of State's own site (sos.wyo.gov, ASP.NET): PDF summaries updated through the night as each county finishes and the Secretary checks it; a results zip afterwards.
WY.site: https://sos.wyo.gov/Elections/ElectionResults.aspx (the 2026 general page will be /Elections/Docs/2026/2026GeneralResults.aspx; its link is commented out today)

feeds.address_pattern: https://sos.wyo.gov/Elections/Docs/<year>/Results/<Primary|General>/<year>_General_Statewide_Candidates_Summary.pdf, ..._House_Candidates_Summary.pdf, ..._Senate_Candidates_Summary.pdf, ..._Judicial_Summary.pdf, ..._Constitutional_Amendment_Summary.pdf, ..._Total_Ballots_Cast_Summary.pdf
feeds.updates: updated through election night as a county reports 100 percent and the Secretary verifies it (2024 page wording); not precinct by precinct
feeds.notes: PDF, not a data feed. Pages answered 200 on 2026-10-09.

feeds.address_pattern: https://sos.wyo.gov/Elections/Docs/<year>/Results/<Type>/<year>_Wyoming_<Type>_Results.zip and <year>_<County>_County_<Type>_PbP.pdf
feeds.notes: The kit reads the 2026 primary zip.

WY.counties_separate: Yes: the state page says county and local results are on the county clerks' sites. Laramie (laramiecountywy.gov Elections), Natrona (natronacounty-wy.gov), Campbell (campbellcountywy.gov/867/Elections), Park (parkcounty-wy.gov/county-elections). Not requested.
WY.kit_already_reads: ballot/lists/wy.py: the general candidate list PDF and the primary results zip. ballot/state_local_wy.py: the general candidates CSV and county clerks' sample ballots.
WY.plan: Readable but slow and in PDF. Poll the general results page every ten minutes or so for new or changed summary PDFs, read them with ballot/pdftext.py, and show each county as 'all in' or 'not yet'. Local results only from county clerks after the night; leave them for after Nov 3.

CO.system: Clarity Elections (Scytl/Civix ENR), results.enr.clarityelections.com/CO, on CloudFront.

feeds.address_pattern: https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/CO/<EID>/current_ver.txt, then /CO/<EID>/<ver>/reports/detailxml.zip (detail.xml: every contest, choice and county); election list at /CO/elections.json?v=1 (gzip JSON: EID, ElectionName, Date)
feeds.updates: new version number each upload (all-mail counting; counties report through the night and for days)
feeds.notes: HTTP 200 on 2026-10-09: current_ver.txt for 126592 = 377440; elections.json lists 2026 Primary 126592, 2025 Coordinated 124409, 2024 General 122598, 2024 Primary 121727, 2022 General 115903. Nov 3, 2026 not listed yet.

feeds.address_pattern: https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/CO/<County>/<county EID>/<ver>/reports/detailxml.zip (each county's own Clarity page, with precinct detail and local races)
feeds.notes: County pages are linked from the state page.

CO.precinct_level: on the county Clarity pages (state page is county level)
CO.vote_types: The state detail.xml has one VoteType ('Total Votes') per choice (ballot/lists/co.py stops if more appear). Colorado votes by mail, so the count-order signal is the order of uploads (version by version), not ballot type.
CO.counties_separate: Yes, on Clarity under /CO/<County>/: Denver, El Paso, Arapahoe, Jefferson, Adams, Larimer, Boulder.
CO.terms: None seen in the API answers.
CO.kit_already_reads: ballot/lists/co.py: current_ver.txt and detailxml.zip for the 2026 primary (126592), stored only where they equal the certified abstract. ballot/state_local_co.py: the Secretary's candidate pages.
CO.plan: Rehearse on 122598. On election night poll current_ver.txt every couple of minutes and fetch detailxml.zip only when the version changes; that gives every statewide, Congress and legislative contest by county. Saving each version also feeds the count-order predictor (how each county's share moves upload by upload). Local results: the large counties' Clarity pages, same reader.
